name: bedrock-multi-model-mcp
description: AWS Bedrock models as MCP tools: ask, compare, judge and panel Claude, GPT, Grok, Kimi, Gemma, Mistral, Nova, Qwen and DeepSeek, plus image, video and embeddings.
long_description: Ask one Bedrock text model, compare 2-5 side by side, have a judge score them blind, or run a turn-by-turn panel discussion. Also generates and edits images, generates video and compares text with embeddings. Needs an AWS account with Bedrock model access: paste a Bedrock API key below, or leave it empty to use your AWS credential chain (profile, environment or SSO).

AWS_BEARER_TOKEN_BEDROCK.title: Bedrock API key
AWS_BEARER_TOKEN_BEDROCK.description: Amazon Bedrock API key (bearer token). Leave empty to use the standard AWS credential chain instead.

AWS_REGION.title: AWS region
AWS_REGION.description: Region for text models. Image and video models use us-west-2 regardless.

BEDROCK_MCP_OUTPUT_DIR.title: Output folder
BEDROCK_MCP_OUTPUT_DIR.description: Where generated images and videos are saved. Empty uses the working directory, then ~/bedrock-images.

BEDROCK_MCP_FILES_ROOT.title: Files folder
BEDROCK_MCP_FILES_ROOT.description: The folder the files option may read text files from. Empty uses the folder the server starts in; file input stays off when that is a home folder or a drive root.

tools.name: bedrock_ask
tools.description: Prompt one text model, optionally with a JSON schema or effort level.

tools.name: bedrock_compare
tools.description: Send one prompt to 2-5 models and show the answers side by side.

tools.name: bedrock_judge
tools.description: 2-5 models answer, a judge model scores them blind and picks a winner.

tools.name: bedrock_panel
tools.description: 2-5 models discuss one prompt in turn, each seeing the earlier turns.

tools.name: bedrock_list_models
tools.description: List the available text, image, video and embedding models.

tools.name: bedrock_generate_image
tools.description: Generate an image from a prompt and save it locally.

tools.name: bedrock_edit_image
tools.description: Run one of the Stability image edit services on a local image.

tools.name: bedrock_video_status
tools.description: Check a video generation job and fetch the result.

tools.name: bedrock_embed_similarity
tools.description: Cosine-similarity matrix across two or more texts.

tools.name: bedrock_doctor
tools.description: Probe every text model and report which work on this account.
